consequence.statement: The new value defaults to false, so nothing changes unless the operator opts in. If set, HTTP-01 ACME challenges are disabled and cert-manager drops its permission to create pods.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds the opt-in Helm value `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, which defaults to false; setting it disables HTTP-01 ACME challenges so cert-manager no longer needs permission to create pods.
